assumption: Although Data is formally listed in SWS_Dcm_91085 as "Parameters (in) Data Pointer to the data to be written", Data is the buffer for providing the response data.
rationale: According to the functional description, this parameter is used to pass the upload data to be sent to the client in response to TransferData.
